meta.title: Create App
meta.ai_context: The user is on the Create App page, where they can generate a new AI-powered app using the Studio builder.

meta.title: Apps
meta.ai_context: The user is on the Apps page, showing all apps in this workspace. Each app can be clicked to open App Studio for configuration, usage, and health details.

meta.title: Token Usage
meta.ai_context: The user is on the Workspace Token Usage page. It shows LLM token consumption, cost estimates, and chat activity across all apps in this workspace.

meta.title: Users
meta.ai_context: The user is on the Workspace Users page. It shows total, active, and new user counts across all apps with a per-app breakdown. Clicking an app row navigates to the app access page for the full user list.

meta.title: Integrations
meta.ai_context: The user is on the workspace Integrations page. It shows shared services by task state: app-used services needing setup, connected services ready for reuse, and available services for future apps. Secret values are never displayed.

meta.title: Support
meta.ai_context: The user is on the workspace Support page. It lists apps with support activity and links each row to the app support dashboard for chat details.

meta.title: App Studio
meta.ai_context: The user is in App Studio, the management interface for a specific app. They can review build status, configure workflows, and manage the app lifecycle.

meta.title: App Overview
meta.ai_context: The user is on the App Overview page in App Studio. It shows the app's identity, top-level KPIs, build state, and recent activity.

meta.title: Building
meta.ai_context: The user is on the App Building portal. It renders dashboard.yaml build panels for build requests, artifact versions, approval state, and workflow launch actions.

meta.title: App Users
meta.ai_context: The user is on the App Users page. It shows accounts, access status, subscription plan assignment, and last-activity for this app's users.

meta.title: Token Usage
meta.ai_context: The user is on the App Token Usage page. It shows LLM token consumption, cost estimates, and per-workflow chat breakdowns for this specific app.

meta.title: App Health
meta.ai_context: The user is on the App Health page. It shows runtime signals, connector status, and any warnings or errors for this app.

meta.title: App Integrations
meta.ai_context: The user is on the App Integrations page. It shows required, optional, and app-specific services for one app, with live workspace setup status overlaid.

meta.title: App Support
meta.ai_context: The user is on the App Support page. It shows support chats for one app using a simple support taxonomy: Needs reply, Responded, and Resolved.

meta.title: Build Review
meta.ai_context: The user is on the App Build Review page. It shows artifact versions, validation state, review actions, and staged output for this app.
